title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Porosity in metal-oxide nanomaterials can be created by templating, nanoparticle self-assembly, reinforced crystallization, or topochemical conversion.
explanation: The review lists soft and hard templates among five established pore-generation approaches and notes that combining template types can yield hierarchical pores.
conditions: Template amount, placement and removal, or reaction conditions during assembly and transformation, affect the resulting pores.
caveats: Precise, reproducible control of pore structure and density remains a challenge despite successful pore creation.
